projects.title: VFoster — Restaurant Management SaaS
projects.bodyText:
- Multi-tenant SaaS **running in production** for multiple restaurants.
- Each restaurant gets its own subdomain or custom domain and an **isolated PostgreSQL schema**.
- Orders, menu, tables with QR codes, cash register and finance, inventory, customers, franchises, analytics and a public ordering site.
- Integrations: **iFood** and **99Food** order intake, **Stripe** subscriptions, **WhatsApp** chat with automation flows.
- Background workers with **BullMQ/Redis**; Dockerized deploy behind Nginx with CI/CD on GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Conexão Web — Internal Management System
projects.bodyText:
- Internal platform used daily by the teams of **Conexão Web Telecom**, an internet service provider.
- Modules for step-by-step process guides, inventory, service orders, tickets, users and permissions, support guide and dashboards.
- Integration with the **Hubsoft** ISP ERP (REST and GraphQL).
- Companion mobile app for field technicians built with **React Native (Expo)**.
- Express + MySQL backend with versioned migrations and automated tests.

projects.title: Indique e Ganhe — Referral Program
projects.bodyText:
- Customer referral program for Conexão Web: a **public portal** where customers refer friends, plus an internal CRM panel.
- Validates each referral against **Hubsoft** and tracks it from prospect to installation and first payment.
- Applies rewards automatically in Hubsoft billing (discount or waived invoice), with an approval flow and protection against double rewards.
- Program dashboard: funnel by cohort, conversion rate, time to install, reward cost and top referrers.
- Explainer videos generated from code animations with **Playwright** and **FFmpeg**.

projects.title: Conexão Web — Fleet Management
projects.bodyText:
- Fleet module of the Conexão Web internal system, used to run the company vehicles.
- Vehicles, drivers, fueling, maintenance, gas stations, workshops and vehicle documents.
- Fuel consumption analytics and odometer tracking derived from fueling and maintenance records.
- Recurring maintenance by km or days, maintenance items with attachments, document and driver license expiry dates.
- Full audit trail and role-based permissions; records are deactivated, never deleted.

projects.title: Dev Portfolio
projects.bodyText:
- Developer portfolio website built with **Angular 22** (standalone components and signals).
- Fully data-driven: content comes from JSON files, easy to update.
- Light and dark themes, responsive layout and smooth page transitions.

projects.title: Gemini Chat
projects.bodyText:
- A modern chat application powered by Google's Gemini AI model for intelligent conversations and assistance.
 - Features real-time chat interface with natural language processing capabilities.
 - Built with Next.js/React.js frontend and Node.js backend.
 - Implements WebSocket for real-time communication.
 - Secure integration with Google's Gemini AI API.

projects.title: SmartFleet - Fleet Management System
projects.bodyText:
- A comprehensive fleet management system for organizations to manage vehicle fleets efficiently.
 - Features include real-time tracking, maintenance scheduling, and driver management.
 - Built with a modern tech stack: React.js/TypeScript frontend and Node.js/Express backend.
 - Includes fuel consumption analytics and maintenance history tracking.
 - Complete with reporting dashboard and JWT authentication.

projects.title: Finance Simulator
projects.bodyText:
- A white-label income simulation tool built with Spring Boot and React.
- Simulates compound interest investments and visualizes the results.
- Features interactive charts and a detailed monthly breakdown.
- Supports multiple languages and currencies.

projects.title: MVVM Sample App
projects.bodyText:
- An Android App that loads data from mock API and show in both **LinearLayout** and **GridLayout RecyclerView**.
 - Offline support using **Room** DB and **NetworkBoundResource**.
 - Uses the **MVVM** architecture.

projects.title: RouterControl Bot
projects.bodyText:
- A WhatsApp bot built with Venom-bot and Rasa to control and configure ZTE-F670LV9.0 routers.
 - Reset ZTE-F670LV9.0 routers with a simple WhatsApp command (reset v9).
 - Configure ZTE-F670LV9.0 routers through WhatsApp.
 - Natural language understanding powered by Rasa.
 - Automated browser interaction using Selenium.

projects.title: Task Tracker
projects.bodyText:
- A simple Task Tracker web app made with **Angular 12**.
 - Uses **mock JSON server** to get, add, delete or update tasks.

projects.title: Image Encryption/Decryption
projects.bodyText:
- A Web App for Image Encryption and Decryption made in **Django**.
 - Uses **SDES** algorithm for encryption/decryption.
